description: Modernization tasks for TrafficLights Processing application - Java 25 minimum and containerization

tasks.description: Upgrade the project to a Java 25 minimum; addresses Java Version is not the latest LTS.
tasks.reason: The team selected Java 25 as the minimum to allow Java 25 features.
tasks.requirements: Target Java 25 in Maven and the development container. Validate builds and existing tests on Java 25 and 27, including Processing compatibility. Document that Java 21 users need a separate JDK or rebuilt development container.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for CVEs and remediate vulnerable packages
tasks.reason: Security best practice to ensure the application and its dependencies are free from known vulnerabilities before containerization and deployment.
tasks.requirements: Scan Maven dependencies for known CVEs, remediate vulnerable dependencies, and re-scan. Report unresolved findings and verify compatibility on Java 25 and 27.

tasks.description: Create a Dockerfile for portability; addresses No Dockerfile found.
tasks.reason: Assessment report identified no Dockerfile found. Containerization enables portability across environments and provides optional capability for future Azure deployment, CI/CD pipelines, or team collaboration.
tasks.requirements: Create a Dockerfile using Java 25 or later. Preserve local desktop use and account for the Processing application's graphical display requirements. Verify container build and operation; do not assume cloud deployment.
